text: Henwen is a British goddess of abundance. In British mythology she is a magical sow. Her name means the old white one. She came forth early in creation. Her task was to give life to the world. She roamed the hilly countryside. She gave birth to litter after litter. Each litter produced a strange gift, not piglets. One litter carried a grain of wheat and a bee. Another carried a grain of barley and a bee. A third litter gave a wolf cub, an eaglet, and a kitten. Each strange litter appeared in a different part of the country.
